question: Does a distinct, independently ownable control edge remain for cross-border China ground-truth execution routing after current exact and adjacent incumbent surfaces are accounted for?

current_evidence: Markets one-time/ad-hoc, short-term and ongoing China-side execution to overseas clients.
Accepts scoped objective/location/deadline/evidence requirements and returns photo/video/document evidence and completion reporting where permitted.
Factory/site visits explicitly use checklist-based observations and practical reporting.
Pricing is quote-based after feasibility, travel, risk and evidence requirements.
incumbent_surfaces.consequence: The broad overseas-client -> China local executor -> evidence/report flow is an existing paid service category, not a missing edge.

current_evidence: Current China-local observation jobs carry explicit fixed-price budgets.
Fixed-price project funds can be deposited before work begins.
Talent marketplace already matches clients to individual China-based executors.
Subcontracting is allowed only with client consent; agency contracts provide a transparent multi-person operating path.
incumbent_surfaces.consequence: Buyer discovery, contracting and pre-funded payment are already owned. A new operator must add a distinct control asset beyond proposal/coordination.

current_evidence: Current site describes nationwide mobile crowdsourcing across 500+ cities for data collection, market research and retail audit.
Workflow is request task -> deploy to crowd -> quality check -> receive verified results.
English-facing site describes task preparation, publication, real-time submission, task approval and payment.
Public positioning is an extended field workforce for business clients including international brands.
incumbent_surfaces.consequence: Replaceable local executor network, structured tasking, QA and result acceptance are already mature control surfaces.

current_evidence: Current platform reports a global contributor network across 140+ countries and same-day local data collection.
Place/route tasks can collect photos and geolocation from local contributors.
Quality-control workflows validate submissions before delivery.
Data can be exposed in dashboards and, in documented workflows, via API.
incumbent_surfaces.consequence: The generalized remote-principal -> local crowd -> structured evidence/QA mechanism exists globally.

current_evidence: Current official site exposes MCP Server, CLI, Agent Skill and OpenAPI.
MCP tools include quote, order, query, cancel and track.
Evidence-specific photo/checklist acceptance is not proven on this rail.
incumbent_surfaces.consequence: Even the proposed machine-native physical-dispatch advantage is being absorbed by a mature local platform; evidence semantics alone would be a thin feature unless backed by a distinct asset.

remaining_narrow_hypothesis: Machine-native cross-border scope normalization plus evidence acceptance across multiple China execution rails.
narrow_hypothesis_assessment: No proprietary buyer-intent rail is evidenced; initial acquisition still depends on third-party marketplaces or manual sales.
No exclusive executor supply is evidenced; large incumbent crowds and local-service networks already exist.
No exclusive action right is evidenced; physical task dispatch can be bought from existing platforms.
No proprietary outcome/data loop exists before transactions, and generic evidence schemas/checklists are reproducible by agents and incumbents.
The remaining integration layer is therefore highly vulnerable to generic-agent substitution and incumbent absorption.
next_boundary: Return to precedent-calibrated formation-diverse broad reality in Scan 127. Preserve paid ground-truth tasks as a reality sensor, not a fallback business. Do not derive another China-helper variant from this closure.
